reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 16 points better, in a game of about 240 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Timberwolves (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 92 times in 100, by about 17; most games like this end between 214 and 262 total points.
